name: helix-vscode
description: A VS Code sidebar Webview UI for Helix.

commands.title: Helix: Capture Next Provider Request Body

deepseekHarness.model.description: Selected Harness model identifier. Managed by the sidebar model picker.

deepseekHarness.contextWindow.description: Selected model context window in tokens. Managed by the sidebar model picker.

deepseekHarness.baseUrl.description: Optional DeepSeek-compatible API base URL. Empty uses the provider default.

deepseekHarness.sandboxMode.description: Sandbox permission mode for DSH sessions.

deepseekHarness.mcpServers.description: MCP servers attached to the DSH runtime. Secret environment values are stored in VS Code SecretStorage.

deepseekHarness.dshBin.description: Optional path to a dsh CLI module. Empty uses the matching bundled @deepseek-ai/dsh runtime.

deepseekHarness.dshHome.description: Optional Harness home directory. Empty inherits the normal Harness home.

deepseekHarness.maxSelectionCharacters.description: Maximum selected editor characters sent as prompt context.

deepseekHarness.maxBrowserContextCharact.description: Maximum HTML and CSS characters sent across browser element attachments per prompt.

deepseekHarness.experimentalSkillPicker.description: Enable the experimental Skills drawer and decisions connection controls. When off, skill routing and preloading are disabled; the agent can still discover and load skills normally.

deepseekHarness.decisions.description: Automatic skill-selection decisions connection. Configure it in the sidebar connection settings.

deepseekHarness.skillSelectionThreshold.description: Minimum yes probability for automatic skill selection. Tune for your decisions model.

scripts.compile: npm run clean && npm run build:webview && tsc -p .
scripts.test: npm run compile && node --test out/test/prompt-context.test.js out/test/browser-context.test.js out/test/user-question.test.js out/test/model-catalog.test.js out/test/mcp.test.js out/test/control-bridge.test.js out/test/dsh-control-plugin.test.js out/test/harness-runtime.test.js out/test/session-controller.test.js out/test/session-hierarchy.test.js out/test/serial-task-queue.test.js out/test/streamed-step-tracker.test.js out/test/compaction-history.test.js out/test/live-tool-call-tracker.test.js out/test/request-preview-view.test.js out/test/reasoning-effort-request.test.js out/test/decision-client.test.js out/test/skill-controller.test.js out/test/dsh-skill-bridge.test.js out/test/decision-settings.test.js out/test/skills-runtime.test.js
